name: open-app-catalog
description: Hugging App: an open App Store chart catalog for design research

scripts.check:syntax: for f in site/*.js site/*.mjs worker/index.js scripts/*.mjs tests/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/worker.test.cjs tests/accounts.test.cjs tests/snapshot.test.cjs tests/board.test.cjs tests/views.test.cjs tests/git-guard.test.cjs
scripts.verify:fast: npm run format:check && npm run check:syntax && npm run typecheck && npm run test:pipeline && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run check:syntax && npm run typecheck && npm run test:pipeline && npm run build:pages && npm run test:site
